name: dopemux-route-ledger
description: Route ledger for Claude Code: records the model each Agent call requests (warning when none is pinned) and the model and advisor server-tool-uses each model step reports, as JSONL receipts a supervisor can merge into an ExecutionBinding. Read-only: it never rewrites, denies or retries a call.

receiptDir.title: Receipt directory
receiptDir.description: Where receipt files (<sessionId>.jsonl) are written. The default is used only when .control-tower/state exists; an explicit directory is created on first write. Receipts are disabled for a path containing a .. segment, for a directory (or, when it does not exist yet, its nearest existing parent) that is a symbolic link or not a directory, and for a relative path that resolves outside the project root. An absolute directory is allowed.

unpinnedAgent.title: Unpinned Agent calls
unpinnedAgent.description: warn: toast once for each Agent call with no model pinned (forks excepted). off: record only.

childAdvisorBudget.title: Advisor calls allowed per child agent
childAdvisorBudget.description: Whole number. 0 (default) means a child's first advisor call exceeds the budget; a negative number disables the check.

sessionAdvisorBudget.title: Advisor calls allowed per session
sessionAdvisorBudget.description: Whole number. -1 (default) turns the session budget off.

maxReceiptsPerFile.title: Receipts per file
maxReceiptsPerFile.description: Whole number from 50 to 5000 (default 500); a new <sessionId>.<n>.jsonl segment starts after this many, or earlier, at about 3.5 MB.

recordDescription.title: Record the Agent call description
recordDescription.description: Default false: the Agent call's description is not recorded (the receipt keeps an empty description) and the unpinned-agent toast names the subagent type and a shortened tool_use id instead. true: record the first 80 characters and name them in the toast.
